Why has Pakistan’s Democracy Failed? | Flashback with Palki Sharma
Pakistan has held more than a dozen general elections since its independence. Yet, the country is widely considered to be a failed democracy, plagued by military coups and unfair elections. Why did Pakistan’s democratic experiment fail? Palki Sharma tells you on Flashback.
